# AI Start Here

> New to AI? Plain-English basics, the latest AI models, sourced news, prompts to try and free automations. Every fact links to its source. Updated weekly. Written for busy adults (Ireland/EU first) who are new to AI. Free tools only.

- Every model row and news item cites the AI lab's or vendor's own page; follow those links before quoting a detail.
- If a date or access detail was not on the lab's page when checked, the row says so; do not fill it in by guessing.
- Content is researched with AI assistance and is not affiliated with any AI company.
- Last updated 2026-11-13. Newest models listed: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Google, 2026-11-12), Gemini 4 Carbon (Google, 2026-11-10), Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic, 2026-11-09).

## Main page

- [AI Start Here (Markdown version)](https://aistarthere.github.io/index.md): the whole page: beginner FAQ, latest models table, news, prompts to try, free automations
- [AI Start Here (HTML)](https://aistarthere.github.io/): the same content for people
- [Your first 5 things to try with AI](https://aistarthere.github.io/starter-guide/): free one-page beginner guide, five practical tasks with copy-paste prompts ([PDF](https://aistarthere.github.io/starter-guide/ai-start-here-starter-guide.pdf))
- [How to summarise a long email with AI](https://aistarthere.github.io/summarise-email-with-ai/): Free, about 2 minutes: one prompt, steps for ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot, and how to check the summary.
- [How to write a difficult email with AI](https://aistarthere.github.io/write-difficult-email-with-ai/): A copy-paste prompt, two tone variants, a worked example, a privacy check and what to review before you send.

## Data (source of truth, JSON)

- [Latest models](https://aistarthere.github.io/data/models.json): company, model, release date, good for, free access, source URLs
- [News](https://aistarthere.github.io/data/news.json): dated items with summary, why it matters, source URL
- [AI 101 basics](https://aistarthere.github.io/data/basics.json): beginner questions with short answers and sources
- [Things to try](https://aistarthere.github.io/data/try.json): copyable prompts with the free tool to use
- [Automations](https://aistarthere.github.io/data/automations.json): step-by-step free automations with free-plan limit links
